items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Lucille called and said Marge would you do me a favor? And I said anything, I told you Lucille, anything you want me to do. So, I want you to bring Zutty over to the hospital... Louis is asking for him.

ctx.x: In his last days we were with him. And we knew, he sent for us to come to the hospital and they wouldn't let anybody in. And Lucille called and said Marge would you do me a favor? And I said anything, I told you Lucille, anything you want me to do. So, I want you to bring Zutty over to the hospital, tomorrow. I said, well we've been over there but they said no, couldn't have company. Said well bring him over tomorrow Louis is asking for him.

And we went over to the hospital. We were just among the few who got in that hospital. We sat with him. We talked with him. He wouldn't even let the nurses make him lie down. He wanted to sit on the side of the bed. And he sat there and he talked to us. Then he wanted to lie down and I went to get the nurse and I couldn't find her. And I said, Louis I'll put you, I'll fix you. I'll put your pillows back. And I lifted, he couldn't even lift his legs up.

items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The mention of 'Lill' occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('I went up there one night with Lill...'). The [INTERVIEWEE] (Zutty Singleton) does not mention Lill, nor does he confirm or deny knowing Lill in his response.

ctx.x: Beautiful. I. J. Spagen had it then and the Warwick was........

And they would walk up on to the ballroom when they got there. And gee, nobody is going to go for a beautiful new place. Very modern and fashipnable. I went up there one night with Lill and I think there were six people in the place. (LAUGHTER). Oh, it was sad. (LAUGHTER). Oh it was sad.
Yes, that was a floperoo boy, talk about a floperoo.
